summary: Will Olson, 40, of Edwards died of blunt-force chest trauma in a mountain-bike crash ~11:50 a.m. during Stage 3 of the Big Mountain Enduro World Series; fellow riders began CPR, race medics, Mt. Crested Butte police, and Crested Butte SAR responded, a CareFlight paramedic pronounced him deceased on scene, and SAR carried him to the trailhead; the rest of the event was canceled
location: Forest Service Trail 400, Star Pass (near Block and Tackle Trail), Crested Butte area
responding_agency: Crested Butte SAR, CareFlight, Mt. Crested Butte PD, race medics
notes: Parent-opened CBN article this run (run 698); 2015-08-01 Saturday verified via accidentdatacenter.com + VeloNews published 2015-08-02; inserted by run-698 Gunnison chunk.
